title: Modulo (The Remainder Holds)
style: minimal techno, ticking percussion, deep sub bass, hypnotic synth pulses, male spoken-sung, vocoded harmony, 124 BPM, zynthio math foundations, precise, hypnotic
lyrics:
[Intro — ticking clock, sub bass]
(spoken) Modulo. The remainder holds.

[Verse 1]
Divide the number, take what's left
The quotient walks, the remainder's bereft
Clock arithmetic, twelve hour day
Seven plus eight equals three the modulo way

[Pre-Chorus]
Mod twelve, mod sixty, mod two for parity
The wheel keeps spinning with mathematical clarity

[Chorus]
MODULO — THE REMAINDER HOLDS
MODULO — THE WHEEL TURNS BOLD
MODULO — PERCENT SIGN IN THE CODE
MODULO — THE EVEN-ODD ROAD

[Verse 2]
Hash collisions land on modulo bins
RSA and Diffie-Hellman, where crypto begins
Prime numbers spinning in the modular ring
Fermat's little theorem, the secret it sings

[Bridge — spoken]
N mod P. The clock face wraps.
Negative numbers in modular maps.
The remainder always less than the divisor.
The arithmetic, ever wiser.

[Final Chorus]
MODULO — THE REMAINDER HOLDS
MODULO — ZYNTHIO MATH UNFOLDS
MODULO — EVERY HASH AND CHECK
MODULO — THE WRAP-AROUND DECK
